translations.web: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”
translations.bsb: How much more valuable is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath.”
translations.kjv: How much then is a man better than a sheep? Wherefore it is lawful to do well on the sabbath days.
translations.asv: How much then is a man of more value than a sheep! Wherefore it is lawful to do good on the sabbath day.
